geometry.compression: Lossless Meshopt, codec version 0; attributes and triangle topology verified after decode

shadowPolicy: Only standing live trees/saplings and their instanced branches, buildings, and genuinely large rocks. Exclude ground wood/dead fallen trunks/roots, pebbles, ground cover, helper proxies, terrain and water from casting only.

limitations: Procedural geometry and animation are frozen at source frame 37.
Cycles translucency and layered bark shading are normalized to glTF PBR using the supplied albedo, normal, roughness and alpha maps.
The terrain and procedural river material are baked to static PBR maps.

geometryPolicy: Original opaque tree geometry, before ANY Blender collapse; material/normal/UV-aware meshoptimizer LOD, world-space error, original positions only. Foliage and transforms unchanged.

originalTexturePolicy.resolution: Original source raster resolution, rounded up to 4-pixel block alignment where required by KHR_texture_basisu; procedural surface bakes remain 1024
originalTexturePolicy.viewerGround: Original three tiled PBR layers and path/river masks; the old 1K terrain bake is a standalone-glTF fallback only.

shadowSelection.policy: Only standing live trees/saplings and their instanced branches, buildings, and genuinely large rocks. Exclude ground wood/dead fallen trunks/roots, pebbles, ground cover, helper proxies, terrain and water from casting only.

rockCriterion.measurement: Visible-mesh local bounding-box dimensions after absolute node and per-instance scales, independent of world rotation

casterSimplification.method: Original opaque tree geometry, before ANY Blender collapse; material/normal/UV-aware meshoptimizer LOD, world-space error, original positions only. Foliage and transforms unchanged.
casterSimplification.foliage: Existing cutout LOD, UVs and alpha textures preserved

tiledTerrain.sourceMapping: Generated XY (planar terrain UV), repeated before texture sampling
tiledTerrain.normalPacking: OpenGL tangent-space normal RGB, roughness A
tiledTerrain.fallback: The standalone glTF keeps the original low-resolution terrain bake; the viewer installs a public-API PBR material plugin for tiled terrain.

validation.extensionValidation: The standard validator does not understand all used extensions; GPU instance data is checked after lossless Meshopt decoding, KTX2 files are validated with KTX-Software, and the complete scene is rendered in a real WebGPU browser.

crop.distance: Horizontal (XZ) distance to the convex hull of every ruins vertex, in glTF space (the demo mirrors X). The kept distance is frontMetres ahead of the ruins' front (along frontDirection, toward the demo camera), backMetres behind their rear, and linear along the ruins' depth in between.

rules.treeAssemblies: trees built from parts (prototypes of one source object whose counts are multiples of the tree count) are kept or removed whole, by their anchor's pivot; every part follows its nearest anchor
rules.instances: kept when their pivot lies within the kept distance
rules.smallSingleMeshes: meshes up to 20 m across, kept whole when their centre lies within the kept distance
rules.largeSingleMeshes: triangles kept when at least one vertex lies within the kept distance

outline.convention: Distance (m) from center to the kept boundary; sample i lies along (cos 2πi/N, sin 2πi/N) in glTF XZ, N = radii.length.

vegetationTextures.rule: textures used only by trees and ground vegetation (^(pine_|silver_fir|fir_sapling|dead_tree|tree_trunk|tree_roots|grass_|fern_|moss_patch|cover_|dry_branches)): full-resolution level decoded, downscaled (Lanczos 3) and re-encoded with the same layout (KTX2 UASTC 3, zstd 18, mipmaps); duplicates merged

geometryCompression.rule: gltf-transform meshopt (level high): reorder, KHR_mesh_quantization (POSITION 14 bits per mesh volume, TEXCOORD in [0,1] 12 bits, COLOR 8 bits), EXT_meshopt_compression with octahedral 8-bit normals
